name: comp-110
title: Text Align Toggle Group
blurb: Toggle group for selecting text alignment: left, center, or right.
description: Pre-built single-selection toggle group displaying three text alignment options. Uses shadcn ToggleGroup with outline variant. Maintains internal state and allows only one selection at a time.
use_when: Providing a visual text alignment picker in editor toolbars or settings.
avoid_when: Multi-select alignment scenarios—this component enforces single selection.
a11y: ToggleGroup provides keyboard navigation and aria-pressed states. Fully keyboard accessible.
